scope: Bounded web search triage of all thirteen already-frozen source questions; not exhaustive citation chasing, full-text adjudication for every hit, or proof of absence. Original source-screen ledgers retain their sealed-at-screening status.

search_terms: Generalized Metric Repair on Graphs W[2]-hard parameter 2020 2021
metric repair W[2] graph parameter
rows.hit_scope: Later paper proves stronger approximation hardness and fixed-parameter tractability for fixed-constant chordal graphs.
rows.match_audit: Its MULTICUT approximation-preserving reduction and chordal FPT theorem are not a parameter-preserving Set Cover reduction establishing W[2]-hardness for general graph metric repair by number of modified edges. No W[2] theorem was found in inspected sections.

search_terms: shortest three disjoint cycles randomized polynomial time 2022 2023 2024
shortest k disjoint cycles RNC 2022 2023 2024
rows.hit_locator: PDF pp. 1-2, abstract and §1 problem definitions/Theorem 1
rows.hit_scope: Packing Short Cycles proves polynomial time for fixed-k *unmarked* minimum-total-weight vertex-disjoint cycle packing on weighted undirected graphs.
rows.match_audit: The 2021 source's SDC(l,k) requires the cycles to pass through all specified marked vertices, each cycle receiving at least one, and asks for RNC or randomized polynomial time at l≥3. The 2024 theorem omits marked-vertex constraints and does not establish the same algorithmic bound. It is useful adjacent progress, not a direct resolution.

search_terms: lattice-based IBEET flexible authorization CCA2 2021 2022 2023
IBEET-FA CCA2 lattice
rows.hit_locator: 2022 full version PDF pp. 1-2, abstract/introduction and comparison table; official endpoint returned HTTP 403 locally, so public archived full text was inspected at https://iacr.steepath.eu/2022/1693-MoreEfficientAdaptivelySecureLatticebasedIBEwithEqualityTestintheStandardModel.pdf
rows.hit_scope: Asano et al. construct CCA-secure lattice-based IBEET in the standard model and list the 2020 Nguyen flexible-authorization construction as adaptive/CPA rather than CCA. A separate 2023 Li paper gives flexible-authorization IBEET with chosen-ciphertext claims over trapdoor discrete-log groups (https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9955179/).
rows.match_audit: The 2022 paper does not authenticate preservation of the source scheme's flexible authorization variants; the 2023 paper is not lattice-based. Neither simultaneously establishes all three frozen conditions (lattice, flexible authorization, CCA2) under a matched security definition. Full construction/game comparison remains needed.

rows.hit_scope: The 2022 survey treats dependency-driven query optimization and incremental maintenance as practical issues. Independent 2019 DynFD prior art already performs incremental FD discovery outside the proposed in-database FD-table interface (https://hpi.de/en/database-group/projects/data-integration-projects/repeatability/data-profiling/fds/).
rows.match_audit: Incremental FD discovery is not itself novel at the 2020 cutoff. The frozen question additionally demands correctness of an in-database FD table and matched update-plus-query cost versus re-mining, which neither cited item directly tests under verified matching conditions.
